findings.detail: C201 missing issuer_name is real because subtotal/category rows from the investment schedule were emitted as holdings rows; these rows have no issuer by source structure.

rationale: The raw SOI table contains ordinary issuer rows with issuer names, but also subtotal/category rows whose first cell is a total label and whose issuer-related columns are blank. The C201 bundle reports holdings rows with empty issuer_name; the cited source rows show this is not a legitimate position with a missing displayed issuer, but a subtotal leak into the holdings extract.
